{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = (df['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

# Print each number exactly as it will appear in the evidence
print(severe_count)
print(total_patients)
print(fraction_severe)
print(f"{fraction_severe:.3f}")"}
